q: A key distinction between Cognitivism and Behaviorism is that Cognitivism views learning primarily as:

q: Assess the value of spaced repetition as an instructional strategy based on cognitive memory theory.

q: Analyze the implications of long-term memory’s theoretically infinite capacity for educational instructional design. In the previous statement, infinite capacity means:

q: What are the Key Points of Gardner’s Theory?
ex: من ملخص Learning Theories: Key Points of Gardner’s Theory.
ans_text: 1) All human beings possess all nine intelligences in varying degrees; everyone has a different intelligence profile. 2) Education can be improved by assessing students’ intelligence profiles and designing activities accordingly. 3) Each intelligence occupies a different area of the brain, and the intelligences may operate in consort or independently.
